item.title: Meduza: Putin is reportedly open to Article 5-style security guarantees for Ukraine. But what does Article 5 actually say? Would the guarantees require NATO members to go to war if Russia attacks again?
item.description: Sources close to the U.S. negotiating team led by Donald Trump’s special envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner said a ceasefire or a peace deal to end Russia’s war against Ukraine could include security guarantees for Kyiv modeled on Article 5 of NATO’s founding treaty, or even full NATO membership for Ukraine.
